title: OpenAI could release agentic AI tool Operator soon | Mashable
full:
# OpenAI could release agentic AI tool Operator soon

![close-up of man's face](https://helios-i.mashable.com/imagery/authors/03Lp0IEBs8IXYimAPV3941z/image.fill.size_400x400.v1723813500.jpg)
![openai logo on a phone with neon blue background](https://helios-i.mashable.com/imagery/articles/00ACFToknhx7spcEZwcbP2J/hero-image.fill.size_1248x702.v1737477082.jpg)

[OpenAI](https://mashable.com/category/openai) could release its agentic AI tool that could, in theory, autonomously do tasks for you by taking control of your device.

Reports have suggested the tool is getting close to being released. Techcrunch [wrote, for instance](https://techcrunch.com/2025/01/20/openais-agent-tool-may-be-nearing-release/ "(opens in a new window)"), that the tool dubbed Operator looks to be "nearing release," citing, in part, Tibor Blaho, a software engineer who often leaks or uncovers AI news. Blaho [wrote on X](https://x.com/btibor91/status/1881110210867290191 "(opens in a new window)") that he noticed "ChatGPT macOS desktop app has hidden options to define shortcuts for the desktop launcher to 'Toggle Operator' and 'Force Quit Operator.'"

The Information has [reported](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/why-openai-is-taking-so-long-to-launch-agents "(opens in a new window)") that OpenAI targeted January as a release date for Operator. It would reportedly first release a research preview and developer tool. The exact release date remains unknown.

The idea behind the tool is that it can act autonomously to make your life easier — in other words, it could take over your computer and do tasks on your behalf. That means [it could things like book flights or write code](https://mashable.com/article/openai-reportedly-working-ai-agent-slated-january-release). Of course, it could also [make](https://mashable.com/article/apple-ai-news-alerts-suspended) [mistakes](https://mashable.com/article/google-ai-overviews-at-6-months-are-they-better) on your behalf, which is a bit worrying.

Still, for better or worse, it may be here soon.
